_notes: Phase 1 zombies. hp = health. speed = tiles/sec at 1x. damageVsBuildingsPerSec = damage to any building/defense blocking or adjacent to it. damageVsUnitsPerSec = damage to a survivor/defender within attackRange tiles. wallBashMultiplier multiplies building damage against category 'wall' only (brutes wreck walls). threatCost = how much of the horde budget one zombie uses (see hordes.json). loot = dropped on death, auto-collected into storage (clamped to caps). pathCostWeight scales how strongly this type avoids walls in the flow field (lower = more willing to bash; 1.0 = default wall cost from hordes.json pathing).
